mapper.sql: SELECT w.*, q.title, q.type, q.difficulty, q.category_id, q.answer, q.analysis, q.tags, c.name AS category_name FROM wrong_question w LEFT JOIN question q ON q.id = w.question_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mastered = #{mastered}

SELECT IFNULL(c.name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM wrong_question w LEFT JOIN question q ON q.id = w.question_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY IFNULL(c.name, '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wrong_question (user_id, question_id, wrong_count, last_answer) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, 1, #{lastAnswer})
mapper.update: UPDATE wrong_question SET mastered = #{mastered} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wrong_question WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
DELETE FROM wrong_question WHERE question_id IN #{id}
